source_name: 66_01_图片库＆设计资源_中文_女士_Chanel_Pre-Summer_2027_服装__066_media_cha_biarritz_ps27_062_text_description.md
text_description: Cropped runway look showing a dark, tailored suiting ensemble layered over a revealing contrast bodice: an oversized black to deep charcoal blazer with strong padded shoulders, long slightly loose sleeves, notched lapels, a single visible gold dome button at the front, and small flap pockets sits over a low-cut black top or bodysuit. The inner piece has a deep plunging neckline framed by wide off-white/cream bands that angle from the shoulders toward the center bust, meeting at a small gold-toned ornamental clasp or medallion, creating a lingerie-like cutout effect against the chest. Below, high-waisted dark tailored trousers match the blazer in tone and appear loose through the hips, with an asymmetrical wrap-like waistband/front panel and multiple decorative gold buttons placed at the upper front and side, echoing the blazer button. The overall silhouette balances sharp, broad-shouldered tailoring with a skimpy structured underlayer and relaxed trouser volume. Accessories include a chunky short necklace of large glossy amber, brown, and tortoiseshell-like stones sitting high at the base of the neck, adding warm contrast to the otherwise black-and-cream palette. Styling feels polished but slightly undone, with damp-looking loose hair framing the face; footwear and the full trouser length are not visible.
